amount_format.rule: Deterministic from display_quantity. USD abs>=1e9 -> billions with one decimal if needed; abs>=1e6 -> millions; else raw with unit. Never derive EPS accretion, percent of market cap, or fair value. bound=approximately prefixes 'about'/'约'; up_to prefixes 'up to'/'至多'; at_least prefixes 'at least'/'至少'.

invariants: Glance strings are rendered only from these templates plus slot dictionaries plus amount_format/window_format. Free model prose is refused.
After fill, English title has at most 4 words and English subtitle at most 14 words (DESIGN_DOCTRINE.md:25).
Watching lines replace internal weakening conditions. They never use the words falsifier or refutation.
Panel footer is always stance_heads_up, once per panel, never per row.
ZH is equally plain; English state names are not dropped into ZH (DESIGN_DOCTRINE.md:155).
